name: GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) Server
summary: Lists workflow runs from a configured GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) endpoint and registers the bundled ga4gh-wes skill
description:
Lists workflow runs from a configured GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) endpoint. Bundles the `ga4gh-wes` skill.

**Install**: not published to npm or any other package registry. Clone and build the `ga4gh-plugins` repository, then run this package's standalone stdio MCP server with Node, using an absolute path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/susheel/ga4gh-plugins.git
cd ga4gh-plugins && pnpm install && pnpm run build
GA4GH_WES_ALLOW_UNENFORCED_MCP=true GA4GH_WES_BASE_URL=https://your-wes-endpoint.example.org \
  node /absolute/path/to/ga4gh-plugins/packages/wes/lib/bin.js
```

The standalone server has no GA4GH policy enforcement point in scope and refuses to start unless `GA4GH_WES_ALLOW_UNENFORCED_MCP=true` is set. Run the Cordis plugin instead where GA4GH Passport/Visa policy enforcement is required.
